svg.title: Edge and cloud AI workload partition
svg.desc: An edge device handles private, latency-sensitive sensing; cloud systems handle large models and shared state; the AI runtime routes work using latency, privacy, capability, network, and energy constraints.

g.text: The edge/cloud boundary is an infrastructure decision
Move only the work and state worth crossing the network.
Keep latency and private state local; send capability-hungry work to the
